package.name: g1_nav_overlay
package.description: Nav2/slam_toolbox configuration for the G1: nav2_g1.yaml (base, ported from vendor/home2's nav2_omni.yaml) plus per-mode overlays deep-merged by g1_navigation (nav2_g1_sim_overlay.yaml for Gazebo, nav2_g1_mujoco_overlay.yaml, nav2_g1_robot_overlay.yaml, nav2_g1_following.yaml), bridge_gz.yaml (ros_gz_bridge), mapper_params_mapping.yaml and mapper_params_localization.yaml (slam_toolbox). See docs/plan.md.
